title: opencode plugin ABI 2.0
description: Generated from opencode_plugin_abi by `examples/schema.rs`; do not edit. Normative for every binding: `describe` answers Metadata and `create` a Manifest; the host's `call` sends a Request and the plugin's sends a HostRequest, each answered as `x-messages` says by the request's type; a view answers a ViewReply whose tree is a Node, and a draw a DrawList. A field the schema leaves out of `required` may be left out; a reader ignores a field it does not know. A later 2.x minor only adds optional fields, request types and node kinds. The HTTP API's types are references into its OpenAPI document, `packages/protocol/openapi.json`, relative to this file.

Node.description: A node of a surface's tree.

ListItem.description: An item of a list: a node with an id, and the rows assumed until it is laid out.

Anchor.description: One of a named group of a scroll's anchors.

Split.description: A row whose first child the user resizes.

ContentRef.description: Content a view gave the host (`View::content`).

PartRef.description: A tool call of a session, whose output a node shows.

SurfaceInput.description: What a surface's view gets besides the plugin's own state.

SlotInput.description: What a slot passes to what renders in it.

PromptInput.description: The prompt's mode, and whether its details show.

Changed.description: What changed since a render's or a surface's last view.

LocationRef.description: A location: a directory, and a workspace in it.

Frame.description: The frame a canvas draws for: its size in cells, why, and the animation's time.

Duration.description: A span of time in whole seconds and nanoseconds, as serde writes `std::time::Duration`.

Palette.description: Every token of the page theme, by its path.

MountId.description: One mount of a surface; a new generation each time.

Color.description: A theme token path (`text.muted`), a scale step (`interactive.500`), `#rrggbb`, or an Rgba.

Layout.description: How a node takes space in its parent's row or column.

Absolute.description: Where an absolute node sits: cells from its parent's edges, and its paint order.

Width.description: A size in cells or in percent of the parent.

Border.description: A border on a box's edge.

Sides.description: The sides a border draws; all of them when left out.

Click.description: What a click on a node runs.

Action.description: What a click asks the host to do.

ScrollAlign.description: Where a node goes when a `to` verb brings it into view.

Scroll.description: A scroll verb, an effect of a handler; the host clamps it to the content.

Target.description: What a verb or a read names: a scroll of the plugin's surface, or the transcript.

ScrollState.description: Where a scroll is, in rows.

AnchorAt.description: An anchor and its row in its scroll's content.

ScrollEvent.description: What the host tells a surface about its scrolls.

Notify.description: What a surface asks its `layout` call to be told about.

Rect.description: A rect in the surface's own cells.

Top.description: The top anchor of a group in a scroll.

Geometry.description: What a `layout` call gets: this frame's geometry of what the surface named.

TranscriptView.description: The session transcript's scroll, as the host publishes it.

TranscriptRow.description: A mounted row of the transcript.

Metadata.description: What a library's `describe` answers: its nonempty ID, which the host reads before any `create`.

Manifest.description: What `create` answers: everything the plugin registered in its setup.

Command.description: A command: in the palette, as a slash command, and on a keybind.

Scope.description: Where a command holds: everywhere, on one of the plugin's routes, or in the host's base mode.

SlotClaim.description: A slot claim, which a `render` draws.

SurfaceClaim.description: A surface of contract 2.0, without its view.

Layer.description: Keys a plugin takes while its scope holds.

ClaimEntry.description: A renderer claim, without its view.

Request.description: A request the host sends a plugin's `call`.

RenderFence.description: A fence, with the index of its render.

InputTo.description: Whose handler an input request calls.

InputEvent.description: An event the host routes to a handler.

Pointer.description: A pointer event on a node.

ClaimPart.description: A claimed part as it is now.

ToolPart.description: A tool call in an assistant message.

ClaimTool.description: A tool call as a claim's view gets it: the HTTP API's assistant tool part without what the call returned, which its `part-output` source names.

FencePart.description: A fenced code block the transcript shows.

Gutter.description: What a row shows before its title.

HostRequest.description: A request a plugin sends the host table's `call`.

Fetch.description: A request of the HTTP API, which a `reply` request answers.

DialogSurface.description: A dialog whose body is a new mount of the plugin's dialog surface.

SelectAction.description: A footer action of a select.

Panel.description: A panel dialog, whose body is a `RenderNode`.

PanelAction.description: A footer action of a panel.

ConfirmLabel.description: The labels of a confirm's answers.

ErrorDetails.description: The host's view of an error.

TabEdit.description: An edit of the session tabs.

Foreground.description: A program the host runs in the foreground.

OverlayAnchor.description: Where an overlay's top left corner goes.

ClaimReply.description: What a `claim` request answers; a null node leaves the part to the host.

Blob.description: Content: text when it is UTF-8, else base64.

RequestId.description: What a `fetch` or a `foreground` the host takes answers, which its one reply names; never 0, which names no request. One the host does not take, as when its queue of effects is full, answers an error, and no reply comes.

Render.description: What a `render` and a `render-route` request answer.

RenderNode.description: The node tree a render and a dialog body draw.

NodeRect.description: A node's place on the screen.

Focused.description: Where the focus is, for the call's mount.

PluginEntry.description: A TUI plugin, as the host lists it.

KeymapPending.description: A key of a sequence in progress.

KeymapActive.description: A key the sequence in progress may continue with.

Family.description: A session's family: its subagent sessions.

Info.description: The host's version, size and location.

Measure.description: A text as the host's text layout counts it: its cells in a row, and its graphemes.

ImageBounds.description: The bounds of the images a host with `image-bounds` decodes.

DrawList.description: What a `draw` request answers: bytes, not JSON, and none to keep the list the host holds. A version byte (1), then records: an operation byte, the payload's length as a little-endian u32, and the payload. Every integer is little-endian; coordinates are cells from the canvas's top left corner. A color is r, g, b, a bytes. A style is 10 bytes: flags (1 a foreground, 2 a background), attributes (bold 1, dim 2, italic 4, underline 8, inverse 16, strikethrough 32), then the foreground and the background colors, each written whether it is set or not. A border is 0 single, 1 double, 2 rounded, 3 heavy. A reader skips a record of an operation it does not know, which is how a later 2.x adds one; a list the host cannot read fails the plugin, and one over a limit shows a placeholder.

x-records.name: fill
x-records.payload: x: i16, y: i16, width: u16, height: u16, color

x-records.name: text
x-records.payload: x: i16, y: i16, style, then the text in UTF-8

x-records.name: cell
x-records.payload: x: i16, y: i16, style, char: u32

x-records.name: cells
x-records.payload: x: i16, y: i16, width: u16, then each cell's style and char: u32, in rows of width

x-records.name: rect
x-records.payload: x: i16, y: i16, width: u16, height: u16, border: u8, color, background (alpha 0: none)

x-records.name: clip
x-records.payload: x: i16, y: i16, width: u16, height: u16: drawing until its pop is cut to it
